purpose: Accept, normalize, and no-return screen exactly one official post-close upper-limit queue-persistence factor for the fixed three-session A-share research horizon without sweeping event categories, fields, formulas, directions, windows, dates, subsets, or models.

source.credential_resolution: current process environment, then the repository .env parser already frozen for Candidate49, then launchctl

factor.name: tushare_official_limit_up_queue_persistence
factor.signal_timing: after the source session is complete and the provider roster is available; earliest entry is the next accepted local session open
factor.eligible_event_category: limit equals the exact uppercase string U
factor.non_upper_limit_event_policy: a valid roster row whose limit is D or Z receives zero and is not reinterpreted as a negative signal
factor.valid_no_event_policy: an active point-in-time buyable-universe stock absent from a complete non-truncated roster receives zero
factor.final_seal_time_domain: HHMMSS on the discrete A-share event clock from 09:25:00 through 11:30:00 or 13:00:00 through 15:00:00
factor.remaining_session_minutes_definition: For a valid U row, count whole trading minutes strictly after last_time through 15:00, excluding 11:30-13:00; 09:25 maps to 245, 11:30 and 13:00 map to 120, and 15:00 maps to 0.
factor.open_times_domain: a finite integer greater than or equal to zero
factor.formula: For a valid U row, remaining_session_minutes_after_last_time / (245 * (1 + open_times)); for a valid D or Z row or a valid no-event stock, 0.
factor.missing_or_invalid_u_row_policy: fail the entire requested session; do not coerce, drop, fill, or convert it to a non-event zero

freeze_before_source_sync: exact 2019-2023 session calendar and point-in-time buyable universe fingerprints
coverage, capacity, variation, duplicate, uniqueness, and stop thresholds

later_walkforward_only_if_all_no_return_.2024_2025_open_policy: one campaign-wide opening only after the complete finite candidate library, survival rules, costs, gates, data and code fingerprints are frozen; label historically exposed quasi_out_of_sample

terminal_stop_rules: do not retry a failed entitlement or schema acceptance on another date, symbol, field set, or token
do not replace last_time with first_time or add seal amount, turnover, market value, price, return, or an old factor
do not invert direction, remap D or Z, change the 245-minute clock, open-times penalty, event/non-event zero policy, or source timing
do not request partial years, subset regimes, choose event-rich dates, or relax the 2019-2023 support gate
do not read daily prices or forward returns before every no-return gate passes
do not create a Candidate50 or any second prospective ledger
do not create current scores, selections, positions, orders, or investment advice
